title: DFRNT Git-For-Data with TerminusDB
description:
Into data? Cross-organisational data product collaboration is harder than necessary.

Today DFRNT unveils the easy-to-use local-first #gitfordata experience with TerminusDB for semantic knowledge graphs!

Clone, Rebase, Merge, Push, Branches... 
Watch the video for details...

In this video with @hoijnet, DFRNT founder, and @lukefeeney, TerminusDB founder, we show the @DFRNT_com data product builder for TerminusDB knowledge graphs!

In addition to localhost #gitfordata, the latest DFRNT release (March 2023) also includes a long awaited GraphQL browser, and several additional data model improvements.

Like git and github, but for knowledge graphs and data ⛅️

The video features the publicly released SaaS/Freemium @DFRNT_com that orchestrates standard @TerminusDB knowledge graphs using the #gitfordata model.

Try it yourself today with a free trial at https://dfrnt.com
